{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter for new customers reached by paid search
filtered_df = df[(df['channel'] == 'paid_search') & (df['customer_segment'] == 'new')]

# Count total such customers
total_new_paid_search = len(filtered_df)

# Among them, count refunded orders
refunded_in_group = filtered_df[filtered_df['status'] == 'refunded']
num_refunded = len(refunded_in_group)

# Among them, count completed orders
completed_filtered = filtered_df[filtered_df['status'] == 'completed']
num_completed = len(completed_filtered)

# Among completed orders, count converted
converted_completed = completed_filtered[completed_filtered['converted'] == 1]
num_converted = len(converted_completed)

# Compute conversion rate
conversion_rate = num_converted / num_completed if num_completed > 0 else 0

# Print all intermediate values
print(f"Total new customers reached by paid search: {total_new_paid_search}")
print(f"Number of refunded orders among them: {num_refunded}")
print(f"Number of completed orders among them: {num_completed}")
print(f"Number of converted orders among completed: {num_converted}")
print(f"Conversion rate (completed only): {conversion_rate:.4f}")"}
